flow.name: CONVfy WhatsApp Concierge
flow.description: CONVfy's own WhatsApp assistant: greet, answer product and setup questions, capture pricing enquiries for the team to follow up (no prices quoted), and hand off to a human on request.

config.text:
👋 Hello! Welcome to CONVfy — the fully managed WhatsApp CRM and automation service.

We set up, run and support your WhatsApp Business messaging: shared inbox, contact CRM, automated flows, broadcasts and catalog chat ordering.

What would you like help with?
Pick an option below and I'll take it from there.

CONVfy is a fully managed WhatsApp CRM and automation service. We handle the technical setup and configuration for you, and your monthly plan covers the ongoing operations and support that keep it running.
We cover a lot — which area would you like details on?
Your whole team works the same WhatsApp number from one shared inbox — customer conversations, replies and history in a single place. No sharing a phone or logging in as one person.
Build keyword-triggered conversations: welcome menus, FAQ bots, lead capture and order updates — exactly like the one greeting you now. Every flow can hand over to a human whenever the customer asks.
Send approved WhatsApp message templates to your contacts in bulk — campaigns, announcements and order updates — with delivery and status tracking.
Every contact gets a profile with their messaging history, tags, pipelines and notes, so your team always has full context before replying.
Connect your WhatsApp Business catalog and let customers browse and order products directly in chat.

We do the technical work. You tell us how your business works and how you want customers handled; we set up your WhatsApp Business connection, CRM configuration and automation flows, test everything with you, and launch. After launch, your monthly plan keeps it running, maintained and supported.

We do. One-time setup covers the WhatsApp Business connection, your CONVfy configuration, CRM setup and your initial automation flows — including testing and launch assistance. You don't need technical knowledge; you just review the setup before we go live.

config.prompt_text:
Pricing depends on your business and what you need WhatsApp to handle.

Tell us a little: what business are you running, and how would you like customers to reach you — e.g. customer support, order updates, lead capture? Our team will review and get back to you with the right plan.

config.text: Thank you — we've noted your requirement and a member of our team will reach out shortly with the right plan for you.

config.note: Pricing enquiry — requirement: {{vars.pricing_requirement}}. Reach out with the right plan.

config.prompt_text: Of course! Tell us briefly what you need and a member of our team will jump in.

config.text: Thanks — a team member is on it and will reply shortly.
Anything else I can help you with?
